requirements.businessContext: TVT playoff lifecycle covers bracket seeding from league-stage standings, per-gameweek advancement, Challenger Cup parallel competition (32-team), Challenger Survival individual-score round (GW33), public bracket + Hall of Champions endpoints, and restoring playoff state via the unified TVT restore endpoint. Behavior branches by league teamSize (8, 16, 32) and by playoffStartGw config — each variant has its own seeding tables, GW count, and tie-leg topology (1-leg KO, 2-leg aggregate, or 3-leg aggregate for 16T Championship Final/3rd).

businessRules.rule: All admin playoff endpoints (generate-playoffs, advance-playoffs, generate-brackets, restore-tvt) require an authenticated admin or superadmin authorized for the target leagueId; otherwise respond 403 Forbidden.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/generate-playoffs is idempotent-protected: if any tie with one of the initial round names for the variant (TVT-8 = ['8T-SF']; TVT-16 = ['16T-CA','16T-CB','16T-XA','16T-XB']; TVT-32 = ['RO16','C-31']) already exists for the league, returns 400 with 'Initial playoff ties already exist for this league. Delete them first to regenerate.'
League stage end is computed as playoffStartGw - 1; standings used to seed the bracket count only results from GW1 through that boundary (chips processed after that boundary are excluded).

Standings sort order for seeding is leaguePoints desc → pointsFor desc → cbpPoints desc; group A/B rankings are assigned independently when both groups exist, else all teams collapse into groupA with a single 1-N ranking.
TVT-32 seeding for RO16 is cross-group: A1-B8, B1-A8, A2-B7, B2-A7, A3-B6, B3-A6, A4-B5, B4-A5 (RO16-A through RO16-H), played 2-legged at playoffStartGw + 0/+1.

TVT-32 Challenger C-31 seeding pairs A9-B14, A10-B13, A11-B12, A12-B11, A13-B10, A14-B9 (single-leg, GW31) with the A-side always home. The canonical C31_SEEDING_32 table in src/lib/formats/tvt/playoffs.ts is the single source of truth — both the admin generate-playoffs endpoint and the public bracket route import and use this table, so the projected/tentative bracket and the live ties created by generate-playoffs always agree on pairings and home/away orientation.

TVT-16 seeds four 4-team playoff groups from single-group standings using snake assignment: Championship A = ranks 1,4,5,8; Championship B = ranks 2,3,6,7; Challenger A = ranks 9,12,13,16; Challenger B = ranks 10,11,14,15. Each group plays a 6-match round-robin across GW31-33 (one match per GW per pair). Requires ≥4 ranked teams per group or the endpoint returns 400.
TVT-8 seeds two Semi-Final ties (8T-SF-A = rank1 vs rank4, 8T-SF-B = rank2 vs rank3) single-leg at playoffStartGw; Final and 3rd-place are 2-legged across playoffStartGw+1 and playoffStartGw+2.

DELETE /api/admin/[leagueId]/generate-playoffs treats the playoff bracket as one unit and performs a full-bracket cascade in a single transaction: it selects every playoff_ties row for the leagueId, every isPlayoff=true fixture in the league's gameweeks, and deletes their results, then the fixtures, then every challenger_survival_entries row scoped by the league's gameweekIds, then every playoff_ties row for the leagueId. Initial round (RO16/C-31, 16T-CA/CB/XA/XB, 8T-SF) AND downstream advanced rounds (QF, SF, Final, 8T-FINAL, 8T-3RD, 16T-SF, 16T-FINAL, 16T-CFINAL, 16T-WSFINAL, C-32..C-38, etc.) are all cascaded so admin can Delete & Regenerate from a clean slate.

DELETE generate-playoffs also deletes the fixtures linked to the targeted tieIds and (via inArray) any results for those fixtures, then invalidates the league page cache and returns counts of deleted ties and fixtures.

When generating the bracket, the endpoint auto-creates any missing gameweek rows from playoffStartGw through GW38, populating real FPL deadlines from /bootstrap-static where available, else falling back to placeholder deadlines 7*(N+1) days from now at 11:00 with isPlayoffs=true.
Generate-playoffs creates (or reuses) one 'Playoffs' group per league and stamps every generated fixture's groupId to it; this group is also used by advance-playoffs when creating downstream ties.
TVT-32 2-legged fixture IDs follow the deterministic pattern 'playoff-<tieId>-leg1' / '-leg2'; single-leg challenger fixtures use 'playoff-<tieId>'.
POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/advance-playoffs accepts the target gameweek from either query param ?gw=N or JSON body { gameweek: N }; returns 400 if neither yields a valid number.

Advance-playoffs pre-checks every playoff fixture in the requested GW: if any fixture has no result row, the endpoint returns 400 with a list of missing tieIds (with leg suffix), before any DB write. Empty fixture set for the GW also returns 400 ('No playoff fixtures exist for GW… Generate the bracket or the previous round first.').
TVT-32 advance-playoffs only accepts gameweek numbers 31-38; outside that range returns 400 'Gameweek must be between 31 and 38'.

TVT-8 advance-playoffs accepts only playoffStartGw through playoffStartGw+2; outside returns 400. GW playoffStartGw resolves SFs and creates Final+3rd; +1 marks leg1 done for Final+3rd; +2 resolves both 2-leg aggregates.

TVT-16 advance-playoffs accepts only playoffStartGw through playoffStartGw+7. GW offsets 0/1 resolve group-stage 1-leg ties; offset 2 (GW33) resolves the final group stage round, computes standings, then creates SFs (2-leg GW34+35), Challenger QFs (1-leg GW34) and WS Seeding (1-leg GW34). Offset 3 marks SF leg1 done, resolves QFs+WS, creates CSF and WSSF (2-leg). Offset 4 resolves SF aggregates, marks CSF/WSSF leg1 done, creates the 3-LEG Championship Final + 3rd (GW36+37+38). Offset 5 resolves CSF/WSSF, marks 3-leg leg1 done, creates 2-leg Challenger Final, Challenger 3rd, WS Final, WS 3rd (GW37+38). Offset 6 records 2-leg leg1 + 3-leg leg2 done. Offset 7 resolves every final (3-leg aggregate + 2-leg aggregates).
Two-leg aggregate scoring: leg2 swaps home/away, so home aggregate = leg1.homeScore + leg2.awayScore, away aggregate = leg1.awayScore + leg2.homeScore. Home team wins on aggregate ties.

Three-leg aggregate scoring (TVT-16 Championship Final + 3rd only): leg1 original orientation, leg2 swapped, leg3 original; home aggregate = leg1.home + leg2.away + leg3.home, away aggregate = leg1.away + leg2.home + leg3.away. Home team wins on aggregate ties.
Single-leg KO scoring: home team wins on a draw (homeScore >= awayScore). Updates the tie row with homeAggregate=homeScore, awayAggregate=awayScore, winnerId, loserId, status='complete'.

playoff_ties.status transitions: 'pending' → 'leg1_done' (after leg 1 GW advance) → for triple-leg ties → 'leg2_done' → 'complete' (after final-leg aggregate is computed). Single-leg ties go directly 'pending' → 'complete'. Resolve helpers short-circuit if status is already 'complete' and winner/loser are set.
TVT-32 GW31 advance resolves all six C-31 ties (single-leg KO), marks all eight RO16 ties leg1_done, then creates three C-32 ties pairing the C-31 winners A↔F, B↔E, C↔D (single-leg GW32).

TVT-32 GW32 advance resolves the eight RO16 ties (2-leg aggregate), resolves the three C-32 ties, creates four QF ties (2-leg GW33+34) seeded RO16 A↔H, B↔G, C↔F, D↔E from RO16 winners, then seeds 11 Challenger Survival entries for GW33 = the 3 C-32 winners + the 8 RO16 losers.

TVT-32 GW33 advance marks all four QF ties leg1_done, then computes Challenger Survival GW33 scores: for each entry it fetches FPL scores for the team's players (cache-first via calculateTeamGameweekScore), resolves the captain (announced > temp-cap fallback via pickTempCaptain using prev-GW rotation), doubles the captain's net score, sums to total, then sorts entries by total desc, assigns rank 1..N and sets advanced=true for ranks 1..8 (the top 8 of 11 advance). If FPL fetch fails for a team, the entry is recorded with total=0 and an action message asks admin to re-run.

After GW33 Challenger Survival ranks, generateC34AfterSurvival pairs the top-8 advanced entries 1v8, 2v7, 3v6, 4v5 into C-34-A..D (single-leg GW34). If fewer than 8 entries advanced, no C-34 ties are created (silently skipped).

TVT-32 GW34 advance resolves QF 2-leg aggregates and C-34 1-leg ties, creates SF-A (QF-A vs QF-D) and SF-B (QF-B vs QF-C) as 2-leg ties on GW35+36, and creates C-35 (QF loser vs C-34 winner from the opposite half).
TVT-32 GW35 advance marks SF leg1_done and resolves four C-35 1-leg ties, then seeds two C-36 ties (C-35-A vs C-35-D, C-35-B vs C-35-C).
TVT-32 GW36 advance resolves SF 2-leg aggregates and C-36 1-leg ties, creates the 2-leg Final (GW37+38) and seeds C-37-A (Loser SF-A vs Winner C-36-B) and C-37-B (Loser SF-B vs Winner C-36-A).
TVT-32 GW37 advance marks Final leg1_done, resolves C-37 ties, and creates C-38-A (Winner C-37-A vs Winner C-37-B) single-leg on GW38 — the Challenger Final.
TVT-32 GW38 advance resolves the Final (2-leg aggregate) and C-38-A; emits a 'Tournament complete!' action.

TVT-16 group standings (computed from playoff_ties of round names 16T-CA/CB/XA/XB once status='complete') sort by points (W=2, D=1) then GF (goals for, i.e. homeAggregate). The 'Great Cut' at GW33 routes: ChampA[0..1] + ChampB[0..1] → Championship SFs (Elite 4); ChampA[2..3] + ChampB[2..3] → Challenger QFs as 'Relegated 4'; ChallA[0..1] + ChallB[0..1] → Challenger QFs as 'Survivors 4'; ChallA[2..3] + ChallB[2..3] → WS seeding (Wooden Spoon 4). Throws if any group has fewer than 4 ranked teams.
TVT-16 Challenger QFs at GW34: QF1 = ChampA3 v ChallB2, QF2 = ChampB3 v ChallA2, QF3 = ChampA4 v ChallB1, QF4 = ChampB4 v ChallA1 (single-leg KO).

TVT-16 WS Seeding at GW34: WS-M1 = ChallA3 v ChallB3 (winner=WS#1, loser=WS#2); WS-M2 = ChallA4 v ChallB4 (winner=WS#3, loser=WS#4). WS Semi-Finals then pair WS#1 v WS#4 and WS#2 v WS#3 (2-leg GW35+36).

TVT-16 final placements (built by /api/playoffs/winners): position 1=16T-FINAL winner, 2=16T-FINAL loser, 3=16T-CFINAL winner (Challenger Champion), 4=16T-CFINAL loser, 5=16T-C3RD winner, 6=16T-C3RD loser; WS Final and WS 3rd determine 13th and 15th place but are not surfaced in Hall of Champions.
TVT-8 final placements: position 1=8T-FINAL winner, 2=8T-FINAL loser, 3=8T-3RD winner.

TVT-32 final placements: position 1=Final winner (TVT Champion), 2=Final loser, 3=C-38-A winner (Challenger Champion), 4=C-38-A loser, 5/6=C-37-A/B losers (Challenger SFs), 7/8=C-36-A/B losers (Challenger QFs), 9-12=C-35-A/B/C/D losers (Challenger R16).

GET /api/playoffs/winners requires a leagueSlug query param (returns 400 if missing, 404 if no league matches); responds with { concluded, winners[] } where each winner row carries { position, label, category, pending, placeholder?, teamId, teamName, players[] }. concluded=true only when every position is filled (no pending entries).

Hall of Champions pending rows carry placeholder text 'Winner of <tieId>' or 'Loser of <tieId>' depending on which side the position is sourced from; auction and Triple Crown formats gate awards on isGw38Settled (all GW38 fixtures have results).

GET /api/playoffs/bracket?leagueSlug=… returns three modes — 'tentative' (no ties yet, latest completed GW < league stage end), 'projected' (no ties yet but league stage complete), 'live' (any playoff_ties row exists). Tentative/projected modes label each side with both seedLabel and team name when a team can be projected; placeholder-only when standings can't yet name the team.

Live mode merges DB tie rows with placeholder rounds for not-yet-created downstream ties, resolving winner/loser labels to real team data once upstream ties complete; result is cached per-league via setCachedPlayoffBracket and re-read via getCachedPlayoffBracket on subsequent requests (cache misses fall through to DB).

Bracket live-scores endpoint pulls scoring per GW: finished GW (every fixture has a result) reads from results table including stored homePlayerScores/awayPlayerScores JSON (legacy isAutoAssigned normalized to isTempCaptain); in-progress GW (some fixtures scored) reads from Redis live cache with FPL fallback; deadline-passed-but-unscored fetches live from FPL and seeds Redis cache.

Bracket live captain resolution falls back to a temp captain (pickTempCaptain on net score, rotates vs previous GW's captain on tie) when no announced captain exists, and marks the resulting player breakdown with isTempCaptain=true; auto-assigned-after-deadline captains (gameweek_captains.isValid===false) also flag isTempCaptain.

Challenger Survival entries (GW33, TVT-32 only) are individual scores not head-to-head: row carries gameweekId, teamId, score, rank (nullable until ranked), advanced bool, optional playerScores JSON. Cascades on team or gameweek delete.
Survival entries are seeded with id pattern 'survival-gw33-<teamId>'; if /generate-c34 is re-run before survival ranks exist, no C-34 ties are created (the helper silently returns when ranked < 8).
POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/restore-tvt enforces league.format === 'tvt'; non-TVT leagues respond 400 ('Restore is for TVT-format leagues only'); missing league responds 404.

Restore-tvt accepts either multipart/form-data with a 'file' Blob (parsed via parseRestoreZip) or JSON body { backupId }. Multipart path requires meta.json present in the zip; rejects with 400 if missing, if meta.leagueId differs from target leagueId, or if meta.format is present and != 'tvt'. backupId path scopes the SELECT by (id, leagueId), preventing cross-league restore via id.

Restore-tvt wipes every fixture for the league's gameweeks then re-inserts from the payload (ON DELETE CASCADE on results.fixture_id wipes results). Teams are preserved. Per-row resolution: row with non-numeric or out-of-range (1..38) gameweek is skipped with warning; row with unknown home/away login is skipped with warning. Missing gameweek rows are auto-created with placeholder deadlines and isPlayoffs=(gwNumber >= playoffStartGw).

Restore-tvt's wipe phase clears every fixture for the league's gameweeks, every challenger_survival_entries row whose gameweekId is in the league's gameweekIds, and every playoff_ties row for the leagueId, BEFORE re-inserting fixtures from the payload. This returns the league to a pre-playoff state matching the restored fixtures so advance-playoffs has no stale aggregate/winner rows and the public bracket route surfaces no phantom winners. Captains and chips are still deferred and surfaced as warnings.

restore-tvt has maxDuration=60 (Vercel function timeout extension); response includes fixturesInserted count, warnings[], and a message reminding admin to use Import Captain/Chip Data blocks for those.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/generate-brackets and DELETE counterpart are Triple Crown ONLY: non-triple-crown formats receive 400 ('Bracket generation only available for Triple Crown format'). (TVT formats use /generate-playoffs instead.) This endpoint is therefore OUT OF SCOPE for TVT lifecycle but the format guard belongs to TVT-playoff coverage.

Tentative bracket for TVT-16 mirrors the live 16-team topology so the public projection does not flip shape once generate-playoffs runs. buildTentative16Team snake-seeds four playoff groups from standings.groupA — Championship A = ranks 1/4/5/8, Championship B = ranks 2/3/6/7, Challenger A = ranks 9/12/13/16, Challenger B = ranks 10/11/14/15 — and emits each group with 4 standings rows (zeroed) plus a 6-match round-robin spanning GW31..GW33 generated from the shared CHAMP_GA/CHAMP_GB/CHALL_GA/CHALL_GB_MATCHES tables (round prefixes 16T-CA / 16T-CB / 16T-XA / 16T-XB). Downstream: tvt.sf carries two 2-leg Championship SFs (GW playoffStartGw+3/+4) with placeholders 'Champ A 1st' vs 'Champ B 2nd' and 'Champ B 1st' vs 'Champ A 2nd'; tvt.final is a single 3-leg tie (gw1/gw2/gw3 = +5/+6/+7) seeded 'Winner of 16T-SF-A' vs 'Winner of 16T-SF-B'; tvt.thirdPlace is a 3-leg tie at the same GWs seeded from the SF losers; challenger.c34 holds four Challenger QFs (1-leg, GW+3) pairing Championship 3rd/4th with Challenger 1st/2nd, challenger.c35 holds two 2-leg Challenger SFs (GW+4/+5), and challenger.c36 holds the 2-leg Challenger Final (GW+6/+7). Group entries that cannot be projected from current standings still emit a placeholder name like '<ordinal> (Group A)'.

Public bracket fixture lookup uses two strategies: the deterministic 'playoff-<tieId>[-legN]' pattern for TVT, and a tieId+leg index for TC (where fixture IDs are random); leg2 scores are unswapped back to home/away on read so the UI shows the consistent orientation.

playoff_ties.tieId is the primary key (global, not scoped by leagueId); generation/advancement queries always co-filter on leagueId so two leagues can hold their own ties for the same tieId values, but a row insert with an existing tieId is silently no-op'd via onConflictDoNothing in 1-leg/2-leg/3-leg create helpers.
Generate-playoffs and advance-playoffs always call invalidateLeaguePageCache(leagueId) before returning success so the next bracket/winners GET re-fetches fresh state.

When two players on the same surviving team tie on net score, pickTempCaptain rotates: it picks the player who was NOT the previous GW's captain (when previous-GW data exists), else it picks deterministically; the chosen captain's net score is doubled in the Survival total.

Standings used for tentative-mode bracket are computed from non-playoff PL fixtures only (fixture.isPlayoff=false AND (competitionType null OR 'pl')); teams in the 'Playoffs' group are excluded from the seeding pool.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an unauthenticated request to POST /api/admin/<leagueId>/generate-playoffs
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API responds with 403 { error: 'Forbidden' } and no DB writes occur

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league with no playoff_ties rows and GW1-30 fully scored
acceptanceCriteria.then: 8 RO16 ties (status=pending, 2-legged with gw1/gw2) and 6 C-31 ties (single-leg) are inserted, plus 16+6=22 fixtures, all stamped to the league's 'Playoffs' group, and the response carries success:true with ties[] and fixtures[] arrays

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league that already has RO16 ties
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API returns 400 with message 'Initial playoff ties already exist for this league. Delete them first to regenerate.' and no rows are written

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-16 league with all 16 teams ranked in Group A
acceptanceCriteria.then: 24 ties are created (6 per group × 4 groups) with roundName values 16T-CA / 16T-CB / 16T-XA / 16T-XB; each tie has gw1 in [playoffStartGw, playoffStartGw+1, playoffStartGw+2] per the group-stage schedule and roundType='playoff-group'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-16 league with fewer than 4 ranked teams in any of the four computed groups (Championship A/B, Challenger A/B)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API returns 400 with message 'Not enough ranked teams found. Ensure the league has 16 teams ranked 1-16 in Group A.' and writes nothing

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-8 league with playoffStartGw=36 and 8 teams ranked
acceptanceCriteria.then: two 8T-SF ties (rank1-vs-rank4, rank2-vs-rank3) are created as single-leg fixtures at GW36 with roundType='tvt'; no Final or 3rd tie is created until advance runs

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league mid-tournament with initial RO16/C-31 ties plus advanced QF/SF/Final rows, isPlayoff=true fixtures across GW31-38, and challenger_survival_entries seeded for GW33
acceptanceCriteria.then: in a single transaction every playoff_ties row for the league (initial AND advanced rounds) is removed, every isPlayoff=true fixture in the league's gameweeks is removed along with its results, and every challenger_survival_entries row whose gameweekId is in the league's gameweekIds is removed; the response is 200 { success:true, message:'Deleted <T> ties and <F> fixtures', deletedFixtures:<F> } and the league page cache is invalidated

acceptanceCriteria.given: a league with no playoff ties at all
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API responds 200 with message 'No initial ties to delete' and deletedFixtures:0

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin GETs /api/admin/<leagueId>/generate-playoffs
acceptanceCriteria.when: at least one playoff_ties row exists for the league
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is { generated: true }; otherwise { generated: false }

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league with no GW31 row before generation
acceptanceCriteria.then: GW31..GW38 rows are auto-created with isPlayoffs=true; deadlines populated from FPL bootstrap-static if available else placeholder values 7×N days from now at 11:00

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin POSTs advance-playoffs without ?gw= and without a JSON body containing { gameweek }
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API returns 400 with message 'Gameweek number required (?gw=N or { gameweek: N })'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league at GW32 with 14 of 16 RO16-leg2 fixtures scored
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API returns 400 with an error listing the 2 missing tieIds + leg suffixes; no QF ties are created and no statuses change

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league with no fixtures at all in GW31
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API returns 400 ('No playoff fixtures exist for GW31. Generate the bracket or the previous round first.')

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league with gw=30 or gw=39
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API returns 400 ('Gameweek must be between 31 and 38')

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league with all GW31 playoff fixtures scored
acceptanceCriteria.then: all 6 C-31 ties become status=complete with winnerId/loserId/aggregates set; all 8 RO16 ties become leg1_done; 3 C-32 ties (single-leg GW32) are created pairing C-31 A↔F, B↔E, C↔D winners

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league with all GW32 playoff fixtures scored
acceptanceCriteria.then: RO16 ties resolve to complete (aggregate from both legs, home wins on tie), QF ties (2-leg GW33+34) are created pairing RO16 winners A↔H, B↔G, C↔F, D↔E, C-32 winners resolve, and 11 challenger_survival_entries rows are inserted (3 C-32 winners + 8 RO16 losers) with score=0, rank=null, advanced=false

acceptanceCriteria.given: a 2-legged tie where leg1 was Home 5 - 3 Away and leg2 was 4 - 4
acceptanceCriteria.then: homeAggregate = 5 + 4 = 9, awayAggregate = 3 + 4 = 7, winnerId = homeTeamId, loserId = awayTeamId, status='complete'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a 2-legged tie that aggregates to a level score (e.g. homeAgg=8, awayAgg=8)
acceptanceCriteria.then: homeTeamId is declared the winner (home wins on aggregate tie)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a 16T Championship Final with leg1=60-55, leg2 (swapped) home=50/away=58, leg3=62-59
acceptanceCriteria.then: homeAggregate = 60 + 58 + 62 = 180, awayAggregate = 55 + 50 + 59 = 164, winnerId = homeTeamId

acceptanceCriteria.given: a single-leg C-31 fixture ending Home 70 - 70 Away
acceptanceCriteria.then: homeTeamId is the winner (>= rule), homeAggregate=70, awayAggregate=70, status='complete'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league at GW33 with all 4 QF leg1 fixtures scored AND 11 challenger_survival_entries seeded
acceptanceCriteria.then: all 4 QF ties become leg1_done; for each survival entry the player FPL scores are fetched (cache-first), captain doubled, total computed; entries are ranked 1..11; advanced=true for ranks 1..8; playerScores JSON populated; subsequently C-34-A..D are seeded 1v8/2v7/3v6/4v5 from the top 8

acceptanceCriteria.given: a survival entry whose FPL fetch throws an error
acceptanceCriteria.then: the entry is recorded with total=0 and an actions[] message asks admin to re-run; other entries still process

acceptanceCriteria.given: fewer than 8 survival entries marked advanced (e.g. partial scoring failure)
acceptanceCriteria.then: no C-34 ties are created (the helper returns silently)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league at GW34 with all QF leg2 and C-34 fixtures scored
acceptanceCriteria.then: QF ties resolve to complete, C-34 ties resolve, SF-A (QF-A vs QF-D) and SF-B (QF-B vs QF-C) 2-leg ties are inserted at GW35+36, and 4 C-35 ties pair each QF loser with the C-34 winner from the opposite half

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league at GW35
acceptanceCriteria.then: SF-A and SF-B become leg1_done; C-35-A..D resolve; C-36-A (C-35-A vs C-35-D) and C-36-B (C-35-B vs C-35-C) are created single-leg at GW36

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league at GW36
acceptanceCriteria.then: SF aggregates resolve; C-36 ties resolve; the 2-leg Final is created at GW37+38 between SF-A winner and SF-B winner; C-37-A and C-37-B pair SF losers with C-36 winners (loser SF-A vs winner C-36-B; loser SF-B vs winner C-36-A)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league at GW37
acceptanceCriteria.then: Final becomes leg1_done; C-37 ties resolve; C-38-A (Challenger Final, single-leg GW38) is created from the C-37 winners

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league at GW38 with the Final's leg 2 scored and C-38-A scored
acceptanceCriteria.then: Final aggregate resolves (TVT Champion crowned), C-38-A resolves (Challenger Series Champion crowned), and actions[] includes 'Tournament complete!'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-8 league with playoffStartGw=36, two 8T-SF fixtures scored
